sources.title: How to Run Qwen 3.6 Locally - 27B Dense, 35B MoE, and Coding Variants ...
sources.snippet: Originally published on locallyuncensored.com Qwen 3.6 dropped on April 21 2026. Two main families: a 27B dense model that activates every parameter per token and a 35B MoE with 3B active per token. Both ship with vision, agentic coding, thinking-mode preservation, and a 256K context window.
